text:
zoe: Noticed batch of CI SAST jobs failing after last RBAC tidy—403 + KMS decrypt errors on artifact fetch. Repro pipeline 2317.

carlos: Paste a snippet?

zoe: ```fetcher: download failed status=403
error: kms:Decrypt denied for key projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/artifacts-key
file: worker/fetch.go:121```

anita: Looks like the scanner SA lost access to that key. We removed broad keystore roles in the sweep.

sec-oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2024-1324 created and paged oncall.

carlos: Quick unblock: apply a conditional IAM binding with expiry using gcloud: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding infra --member=serviceAccount:scanner@infra.iam --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition="request.time < timestamp(\"2024-06-18T03:30:00Z\")"`

zoe: Did that — pipelines green after grant. Exported audit logs + failing artifacts to gs://sec-evidence/SEC-2024-1324/.

anita: Follow-ups: (1) create a scoped role that only allows decrypt for objects in `projects/infra/.../artifacts-key` with condition on resource name, (2) add GH Action `ci/iam-smoke` that runs `gcloud iam roles test` for scanner SA in infra repo, (3) add alert rule for repeated `kms:Decrypt` errors in SAST/DAST jobs.

carlos: I'll open PRs for role design and the GH action. Assign owner to infra-iam team.

sec-oncall-bot: SEC-2024-1324 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled 2024-06-19T16:00Z.

zoe: Also adding a short compliance note with who changed RBAC and the temporary grant ID. Closing thread.
